run_rattle_test: run the main function to test that ASE rattle does not modify fixed atoms
test_rattle_constraints: test that rattling an ASE atoms object respects FixAtoms constraints on selected layers
create_fcc_slab_with_adsorbate: create an fcc100 Cu slab and add a CO molecule as an adsorbate using ASE
apply_fixatoms_constraint: apply a FixAtoms constraint to fix the bottom two layers of an ASE slab
rattle_atoms_positions: rattle the positions of free atoms in an ASE atoms object with a given stdev and seed
